questions.question: Explain the flow of blood through the heart .
questions.solution_html:

  • Pulmonary artery → lungs
  • Pulmonary veins → LA → mitral → LV → aorta

questions.final_answer: • Pulmonary veins → LA → mitral → LV → aorta

questions.question: Explain the cranial nerves and their functions.
questions.solution_html:
• I smell, II vision
  • III/IV/VI eye movements
  • V mastication, facial sensation
  • VII facial expression
  • VIII hearing & balance
  • IX/X swallowing & autonomic
  • XI shoulder movement
  • XII tongue movements

  • Secretes HCl, mucus, enzymes

questions.question: Evaluate the structural importance of pancreatic islets.
questions.solution_html:
• Islets contain α, β, δ, PP cells
  • Endocrine: insulin, glucagon, somatostatin
  • Rich vascularity → rapid hormone release
  • Maintains glucose homeostasis
